notes: Spec asserts: ready → working, state stays working across the failing bash 'false' attempt and the recovery 'echo recovered' attempt (no flicker to ready or waiting between them), final working → ready. Single-birth session model (muse's session id = directory basename), so session_birth anchors to "start" unpinned. turn_start/intermediate_working/turn_end are ALL pinned same_session_as:session_birth from the outset (not discovered at record time) -- the 2-2 auto-executed-tool-call sibling cell's record pass found that muse's goal-reminder/verify-reminder subagents go straight to working (skipping ready) before the parent's own turn starts, so an unpinned phase can silently match a subagent's own read-only arc instead of the parent's tool-call turn; pinning here avoids re-discovering that vacuous pass. LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-14 (throwaway tmux probe, session 01a09f4d-ae31-7af2-b416-1c6773cd7ed2, outside the repo): exactly one run.started/run.terminal bracket covered both the failing 'false' call (exit_code:1, terminal_status:'failed') and the 'echo recovered' recovery (exit_code:0) with a ~17.3s total turn span and no intervening state churn -- min_delay_ms/duration_at_least_ms below are sized conservatively under that measured span, and this probe is also the first live capture of a nonzero exit_code anywhere in the corpus.

text: User prompt drives ready → working on the SAME session that was born ready (run.started → EventType=user_message); subagents skip the ready birth entirely so this filter excludes them (spec bullet 1)

State stays working across both retry cycles — the failing bash 'false' tool_result (exit_code:1) must NOT flicker the session to ready or waiting before the recovery 'echo recovered' cycle completes (spec bullet 2)
After the successful recovery attempt: working → ready (run.terminal → EventType=turn_done, terminal:'completed') (spec bullet 3)
